note: Statement-deletion sweep over the guards S8 introduced or repaired. gremlins ships no statement-deletion operator (it mutates expressions), so these are exactly the mutations the gremlins run over workflow_artifacts.py cannot produce. The question each row asks is: if this line simply vanished, would ANY test notice? The sweep always runs the whole suite.

mutations.why: S8.7 / RV4: the projection would silently go back to deriving a semantic outcome from an exit code, recording a BLOCKED run as workflow_complete
S8.3: the identity check is what makes the read-back a verification rather than a decorative load; without it a stale or foreign flow_state.json is trusted

mutations.old: status_stream = sys.stderr if output_mode == "quiet" else sys.stdout
mutations.why: S8.4 / I-38: quiet mode's stdout would carry the human status line again, so `fa run ... > result.txt` stops being parseable
S8.4: the workflow would ignore --output-mode and every stage would print a status line to stdout (measured 102 bytes over three stages)
S8.2 / G3: the projection's duration column would go back to a constant, which S9 analytics would read as 'every workflow took no time'
S8.8: writer would ignore FA_STATE_ROOT while the reader honours it — the split brain that made `fa stats --global-history` show an empty history
S8.6 / CT6: a re-eval dying mid repair round would leave no FAILED terminal state, so the run's own artifact would not record why it stopped
